reference: User-attached basic court diagram; center court excluded from changes.
prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Of the two input images, the RED/BLACK/WHITE BASKETBALL ARENA is the EDIT TARGET, and the VERTICAL BLACK-AND-WHITE COURT DIAGRAM is a GEOMETRY REFERENCE ONLY. Output the edited full arena, NOT the diagram.

Redesign ONLY the floor markings on the left and right ends of the arena court to use the simple marking set in the reference diagram, rotated into the existing horizontal court and projected naturally onto its floor:
- One clean outer playing rectangle.
- One three-point line per end: two straight corner segments from the baseline, smoothly joining ONE uninterrupted large arc.
- One rectangular lane per end, retaining the existing black painted lane interiors, with one crisp white perimeter and a single straight free-throw line at its inner end.
- One free-throw circle centered on that free-throw line per end: SOLID semicircle outside the black lane and DASHED semicircle inside the black lane.
- Only the small neat white lane-space ticks along the two sides of each lane, like in the diagram.
- Match the simple balanced proportions and relative shapes in the reference, so the free-throw circle sits close to the three-point arc, as pictured. Both ends must mirror in court coordinates and use consistent perspective, line thickness, and crisp pixel edges.

REMOVE markings absent from the diagram: remove BOTH small restricted-area semicircles currently painted white/red under the baskets; remove the stray horizontal stripe running through each black lane; remove the scattered red diagonal floor ticks, redundant sideline dashes, extra parallel lines, doubled paint edges, and decorative red line fragments inside or next to the lanes. Do not paint a basket/backboard symbol on the floor: the little circles and bars in the plan represent the actual rims/backboards, already present as physical hoops in the arena. Do not add other arcs, circles, labels, or markings.

CENTER COURT IS LOCKED: keep the exact current large red W with white/black outline at its existing size, shape, and location, and keep its existing half-court line. IGNORE the center circles shown in the diagram; do not add a center circle or redesign the W.

Everything outside these floor marking edits is LOCKED: keep the existing arena architecture, red and black seats, stairs, ribbon boards, red-lit entrance bays, main HOME 00 / GUEST 00 scoreboard, both shot clocks reading 24, backboards/hoops and supports, foreground seat backs, hardwood color and polished reflections, black/red court border, original camera, original framing, and retro pixel-art style unchanged. No new people, website text, portraits, UI, dimension labels, arrows, or watermarks. Output the complete wide arena image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing red/black retro arena image with ONLY two localized floor-marking refinements to finish matching the user's simple court diagram.
1. Add the small WHITE LANE-SPACE HASH MARKS missing from both black rectangular lanes. On each of the two long sides of each lane, add four short, straight, perpendicular white tick marks just OUTSIDE the black paint, stopping at the lane border. Keep them neat, evenly spaced, mirrored between both sides and both court ends, following the floor perspective. They should be tiny lane-side marks, not long lines, not red decorative marks, and not random sideline ticks. Add no restricted-area semicircles.
2. Bring each large three-point arc a little closer toward its corresponding basket/baseline so that its rounded inner tip comes very close to the rounded outer tip of the free-throw semicircle, as in the user's simplified diagram where those two curves nearly touch. In this approximately 1670x941 view, the left free-throw semicircle's inner-court tip is around x=466,y=620, while the three-point arc currently bulges to x=560. Bring that three-point tip to around x=478, maintaining a smooth curve and retaining its straight corner segments. Mirror the same adjustment on the right: bring the inner three-point tip near x=1192 to almost meet the free-throw semicircle at x=1204. Do NOT move or resize the lanes or free-throw circles. Do not distort or double any line. Keep a minimal clean separation between these white curves.

Everything else is LOCKED: keep the exact large red W center logo, half-court stripe, black painted lanes, hardwood, empty floor interiors, court border, all seats/stairs/entrances, red scoreboard digits and 24 shot clocks, physical hoops/backboards, lights, framing, camera, and pixel style unchanged. Keep this image's already simplified markings; do not reintroduce extra floor decoration, the removed restricted-area arcs, or the removed horizontal stripes through the lanes. Output the complete wide arena image.
